name: io.github.nimbus-agent/nimbus
description: Search your local Nimbus index and run its built-in agents from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: NIMBUS_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to the nimbus binary. Only needed when the launcher cannot find it on PATH or in a known install directory — most commonly a GUI-launched editor on macOS, which spawns MCP servers without the user's shell PATH.
